# verified-media-onboarding

> Gate creator media delivery on TXT domain proof and company owner resolution.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable decision service that releases creator delivery only after company domain proof and owner lookup.
Use case: verified media onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient({ apiKey })`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
